environment: Local macOS arm64; disposable synthetic SQLite database

method.timing: Median of three warm calls; tracemalloc measured in a separate call
method.comparison: All uncompressed OOXML parts except created/modified metadata timestamps; byte equality for TSV; full snapshot dictionaries

limitations: Not production latency or total process RSS. XLSX generation and snapshot reads are separate fixtures; lower snapshot allocation does not imply the same reduction for total workbook memory. Query counts exclude authentication and fetching the circle.
